transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. Can you please tell me what brings you in to see me today?
I've been feeling really down and depressed lately. For about the last two months, I've just completely lost interest in all the things I used to enjoy doing.
Have you experienced any periods of elevated mood, irritability, or increased energy over the past two months, even if they seemed fleeting or not as pronounced as your current depressive symptoms?
No, I haven't had any moments of high energy or feeling unusually happy or irritable. Lately, I've mostly just felt really down and completely lacked the motivation to do anything.
Have you experienced any unusual thoughts, such as hearing voices or seeing things that others can't, or had any beliefs that seem unrealistic to others, during this period of feeling down?

No, I don't hear or see things that aren't there. But I do have this constant feeling that I'm somehow responsible for terrible things happening in the world, like accidents or disasters. Everyone tells me it's impossible for me to have caused them, but I just can't shake the belief that it's my fault.

Do you find yourself repeatedly thinking about these beliefs of being responsible for terrible things, and do you feel compelled to perform any specific rituals or behaviors to try to alleviate these thoughts or prevent these events from happening?
Yes, I constantly dwell on these thoughts and keep blaming myself for all these terrible things. But I don't do any physical rituals or specific behaviors to try and prevent them.
Do you believe these thoughts about being responsible for terrible things are definitely true, or do you have some doubt about their validity, even if the doubt is small?
There is no doubt in my mind at all. I am absolutely certain that I am the one responsible for these terrible things happening. I just know it is entirely my fault, no matter what anyone else says.
How have these beliefs and feelings of responsibility affected your daily life and relationships with others over the past two months?

These feelings of guilt have been going on for the last two months, and they have completely taken over my life. I've stopped talking to my friends and family because I feel like a massive burden to them. I also have absolutely no motivation left to do my job or handle any of my daily tasks.

Are your feelings of depression, such as loss of interest and motivation, secondary to your delusional beliefs of being responsible for terrible things, or do you experience depressive symptoms independently of these beliefs?

I'm really not sure how they are connected or which one started first. All I know is that I feel a profound sense of guilt and, at the same time, a complete lack of interest and motivation. Both of these feelings are just constantly there and feel very overwhelming.
Can you tell me more about when these delusional beliefs and depressive symptoms started, and did one seem to precede the other or did they start around the same time?

Both the intense guilt and my lack of interest have been going on for about two months now. I'm really not sure if one started before the other, or if they both began at the exact same time. It all just seemed to happen together and has been constant since then.
Do your delusional beliefs of being responsible for terrible things dominate your thoughts and emotions most of the time, or are they more of a component of your overall depressive state?

I would say they are a heavy, constant component of my overall depressed state. For the past two months, this deep feeling of being responsible for terrible things has just been a major part of how down and empty I feel every day.
Are there any other delusional beliefs you have besides the one about being responsible for terrible things, or is this the only fixed belief that you've been experiencing?
No, I don't have any other beliefs like that. This overwhelming feeling of responsibility and guilt for all the terrible things happening is the only one, but it is constantly weighing on me.
